g.text: Post-hoc common-denominator analyses; the stricter protocol matches bilateral disease signature and right-eye quality tier.

Thin offset whiskers: envelope of five separate 95% patient-node bootstrap intervals (conditional on fixed assignments; not pooled). The two matching schemes use different quality aggregation levels; AUROC differences are not causal effects.
